rules.title: A simple board with a daring finish
rules.description: Nine horses race across a nine-by-nine board. A player wins by clearing the opposing rank or by completing an escape from e5.

goal.title: Two ways to win
goal.body: Capture every opposing horse, or move a horse to e5, allow one opponent reply, then move that same horse away from e5 on your next turn.

horse.title: The horse
horse.body: Each horse moves like a chess knight: two squares along one axis and one square perpendicular. It jumps over pieces and may capture an enemy where it lands.

center.title: The center is vulnerable
center.body: A horse on e5 can be captured during the opponent’s reply. If it is captured, that center attempt ends.

reply.title: Escape on your next turn
reply.body: After the reply, the same horse must leave e5 immediately to complete the center win. It is not enough just to survive.

endings.title: Digital endings
endings.body: Threefold repetition is a draw; having no legal move is a loss. These are digital conventions. There is no 50-move rule.
